description: Marzanna, the Slavic goddess of winter and death, a tall gaunt pale woman like a straw doll come alive, straw-blond hair braided with dried flowers and ribbons, dark hollow eyes, a long white and grey tattered gown, breathing a cold blue frost, menacing, standing on both feet, full body, three-quarter view, the figure alone, no ground, no background, the whole figure inside the picture
